meta.target: Orbital AI Data Center Economics Model
meta.author: Test plan generated for Libor Ballaty (Arion Networks s.r.o.)
meta.purpose: Executable spec an LLM/browser agent follows to verify 100% of actions, dropdowns, modals and text in the app AND that the numbers produced are physically/economically reasonable.
notes: The app is a single-file client-side HTML calculator. There is no server round-trip; every input change should be reflected after Recalculate (or on-change where the app auto-recalcs).
Control IDs below are stable DOM element ids. If an id is not found at runtime, the agent MUST re-enumerate the DOM (see runner_protocol.self_heal) and report drift rather than silently skipping.
Derived/computed fields are read-only in their default mode and only become editable in an alternate mode (see mode_gated_inputs).
changelog: 1.2.0: designated as canonical manifest; added tag_contract (in-page data-test-* attribute schema) + reconciliation workflow. Companion: OrbitalDatacenterSim-reconcile.js, OrbitalDatacenterSim-tagging-convention.md.
1.1.0: added display_registry (81 non-interactive readouts the user sees) + suite S12; catalog_version bump.
1.0.0: initial interactive control registry + suites S1-S11 + 22 reasonableness rules.
meta.role: Canonical MANIFEST for the app: the single source of rich per-element detail (validity rules, expected direction, formulas, baselines) that the in-page data-test-* tags cannot hold. The reconciliation script (OrbitalDatacenterSim-reconcile.js) checks the live DOM tags against this manifest so the two never drift.

capabilities_required: Navigate to the URL and confirm document.title starts with 'Orbital AI Data Center Economics Model'.
Read/enumerate DOM (ids, values, options, disabled state, offsetParent visibility).
Set a numeric input: focus, clear, type value, dispatch 'input' and 'change' events.
Click any button by id or visible text.
Read <output> and result KPI text after recalculation.
Capture a screenshot for any view/canvas/SVG assertion.
Read the downloaded scenario JSON (or intercept the Blob) for the download test.

value_io.set_number: el = document.getElementById(id); el.value=''; el.value=String(v); el.dispatchEvent(new Event('input',{bubbles:true})); el.dispatchEvent(new Event('change',{bubbles:true}));

run_sequence: 1. SMOKE (S1): load page, assert no console errors, assert baseline KPIs render.
2. RESET baseline: click #reset, click #calc, snapshot baseline KPI vector (see oracle.baseline_kpis).
3. NAV (S2): visit every tab, assert its controls become visible.
4. FUNCTIONAL parametric: S3 numerics, S4 selects, S5 checkboxes, S6 views, S7 modals, S8 actions, S10 catalog/time.
5. VALIDITY (S9): run reasonableness/oracle assertions on baseline and on directional perturbations.
7. Emit report per report_schema. Reset to baseline between destructive suites.

self_heal.on_missing_id: Re-enumerate: [...document.querySelectorAll('input,select,button')].map(e=>e.id). If the labelled control exists under a new id, record a DRIFT finding with old+new id and continue. If truly absent, record MISSING and mark the case blocked.
self_heal.on_disabled: If a target input is disabled/readonly in the current mode, first set the governing mode select (see mode_gated_inputs) then retry; if still disabled, record as expected mode-gating (PASS for gating, skip value test).

runner_protocol.between_cases: Most inputs auto-recalc on change; always click #calc before reading KPIs to be deterministic. After a suite that changed many inputs, click #reset then #calc to restore baseline.

cases.step: Navigate to URL.
cases.expect: document.title contains 'Orbital AI Data Center Economics Model'. No uncaught console errors on load.

cases.step: Read baseline KPIs after load.
cases.expect: capex, tco, tokc, terrTok, nsat, nlaunch, ttft, eavail all present and non-empty.

cases.step: Confirm same-origin gp.json load status line renders.
cases.expect: A catalog/status line is shown (embedded snapshot if no catalog).

template.expect: All controls whose tab=='{key}' become visible (offsetParent!=null); count matches expected_visible_controls +/- documented derived-field gating.

test_suites.name: Numeric inputs — functional

per_input_cases.expect: KPIs recompute without error; value accepted.
Accepted; no NaN/Infinity in any KPI; warnings may appear (record them).

per_input_cases.action: set to a large plausible value (default x10, or max if bounded), recalc
per_input_cases.expect: Accepted; KPIs finite; directional effect matches reasonableness_rules where a rule exists.
Either clamped/rejected OR flagged; MUST NOT yield NaN, blank, or negative $/1M tokens. Record actual behavior.
Ignored/rejected; last valid value or empty handled gracefully; no crash.

test_suites.notes: For mode-gated inputs, first enable the governing mode (see mode_gated_inputs) before value tests; otherwise verify the field is correctly disabled and skip value tests (that is a PASS for gating).

per_select_cases.action: select each option in turn, recalc
per_select_cases.expect: No error; documented 'effect' is observable (e.g., preset options populate their driven inputs; 'custom' unlocks previously-disabled fields).

per_select_cases.action: after selecting an option that unlocks fields
per_select_cases.expect: The fields named in mode_gated_inputs become editable/disabled accordingly.

per_checkbox_cases.expect: Corresponding layer disappears (screenshot diff or documented behavior); no error.

test_suites.name: Views, style toggles, pop-outs, render surfaces

cases.step: Click each main view button (Single satellite, Cluster, System overview, Orbital shells, Shells 3D).
cases.expect: The matching render surface (SVG/canvas) becomes visible and non-blank; view legend text updates.

cases.expect: conceptSvg and/or technicalSvg show accordingly; Technical shows dimension lines/callouts.

cases.step: For each pop-out button, click and confirm a child window opens.
cases.expect: Child window opens same file with ?popout=<view>; child shows only that view with its own controls (regression guard for v5.2).

cases.step: Change a scenario input in parent, recalc, with a pop-out open.
cases.expect: Child view updates live via postMessage (v4.7).

cases.step: On Shells 3D: click scaleTrue / scaleLeo / scaleGeo / resetView.
cases.expect: Radial mapping changes; guide rings adapt; no error. resetView returns to default framing.

cases.step: On Shells 3D: set epoch date, drag t3time scrubber, click t3now, t3play, and speed t3s1/t3s60/t3s600.
cases.expect: Satellites move; scrubber drives time; Now snaps to current UTC; playback speeds differ; Play toggles.

cases.step: Interact with orbitCanvas / SVGs: wheel zoom, drag pan, double-click fit.
cases.expect: Zoom/pan/fit work on conceptSvg, technicalSvg, orbitCanvas, threeCanvas.

cases.step: On Orbital shells view, click loadShell then loadShellPlanned.
cases.expect: pop input is populated with the shell's tracked (then tracked+announced) count; recalc reflects new population.

cases.step: Click Specification (openSpec).
cases.expect: Spec modal opens; markdown renders (headings/lists/tables). On GitHub Pages the sibling .md is fetched. specClose closes it.

cases.step: In spec modal click 'Open in its own window' (specWindow).
cases.expect: Separate window renders same spec content.

cases.step: Spec fetch-blocked path: (simulated/offline) confirm specFile loader is offered.
cases.expect: File loader appears when fetch not allowed.

cases.step: Click Break-even solver (breakeven).
cases.expect: Modal opens with beTarget + beGoal selects and beResult.

cases.step: For beTarget in each option x beGoal in each option: change selection.
cases.expect: beResult updates with either a solved value or a clear 'no solution in range' message (structural). Message must name the searched input and goal; MUST NOT show NaN or empty. Verify: with default util target & mult2 goal, message reports no parity in [1,100]%.

cases.step: Set beTarget=tpsmw, beGoal=terr; read beResult.
cases.expect: Either a plausible tokens/s/MW value at which parity is reached, or an explained no-solution. Cross-check sign vs sensitivity (tpsmw is top driver).

cases.step: Close break-even (beClose).
cases.expect: Modal closes; scenario unchanged.

cases.step: Click Run self-tests (runtests).
cases.expect: Self-test modal opens; in-file assertions run; PASS/FAIL summary shown. Record any FAIL verbatim (these are the app's own regression anchors, e.g. $/1M token anchor).

cases.step: Close self-test modal (testClose).
Change several inputs, click Recalculate (calc).
cases.expect: All dependent KPIs update consistently.

cases.step: Click Reset base scenario (reset), then Recalculate.
cases.expect: Every input returns to registry defaults; KPIs return to baseline vector (oracle.baseline_kpis within tolerance).

cases.step: Click Download scenario JSON (download).

test_suites.note: Every entry in control_registry.display_registry must render a meaningful value after recalc and pass its 'check'. This is the read-side of validity; pair with S9 reasonableness_rules referenced in each entry's 'rules'.

reasonableness_rules.name: No NaN/Infinity/blank
reasonableness_rules.check: After any valid input, all result_kpi_ids render finite numbers (no 'NaN', 'Infinity', '', 'undefined').

reasonableness_rules.name: Non-negative economics
reasonableness_rules.check: capex, tco, tokc, terrTok >= 0 for all non-degenerate inputs.

reasonableness_rules.name: Baseline anchor
reasonableness_rules.check: At reset defaults (v5.4): tokc ≈ $13.971/1M, terrTok ≈ $0.247/1M, tokcmp ≈ 56.5x, nsat=9, nlaunch=9, ttft≈133 ms, eavail≈96.57%. Tolerance +/-2% (the app may evolve; flag as INFO if drifted, FAIL if wildly off e.g. sign flip or 10x).

reasonableness_rules.name: Mass balance
reasonableness_rules.check: Mass-stack subsystem percentages sum to ~100% (+/-0.5%). Wet total = sum of subsystem masses.

reasonableness_rules.name: Satellite count derivation
reasonableness_rules.check: nsat = ceil(target racks / racks-per-sat) + spares logic. At default: ceil(1MW/0.135MW)=8 productive + 1 spare = 9. Changing mw or rps changes nsat monotonically and consistently.

reasonableness_rules.name: Utilization monotonicity
reasonableness_rules.check: Increasing util (1->100%) monotonically DECREASES $/1M tokens (more tokens over same cost). Confirms sensitivity sign (util listed -2.33/+3.49).

reasonableness_rules.name: Throughput monotonicity
reasonableness_rules.check: Increasing tpsmw monotonically DECREASES $/1M tokens; it is the top sensitivity driver (span ~$5.82). Directional and largest-magnitude among single inputs.

reasonableness_rules.name: Launch price direction
reasonableness_rules.check: Increasing lmission (mission price) INCREASES capex and $/1M tokens.

reasonableness_rules.name: Altitude -> latency
reasonableness_rules.check: Higher altitude increases RTT/space-propagation contribution (650km ~6.5ms; 1200km higher). RTT rises with alt.

reasonableness_rules.name: Eclipse-free high orbit
reasonableness_rules.check: Dawn-dusk SSO becomes eclipse-free only at high altitude (~>=1400km): at such alt, worst eclipse -> 0 and battery mass falls to reserve-only. At 650km eclipse ~19-20 min.

reasonableness_rules.name: Battery sizing responds to eclipse
reasonableness_rules.check: Longer eclmax (preset mode) increases battery nameplate & mass; shorter decreases. In geom mode, higher alt (less eclipse) reduces battery.

reasonableness_rules.name: Cost regime sensitivity
reasonableness_rules.check: costPreset constellation yields much lower $/1M tokens than traditional; the app explicitly flags high sensitivity to manufacturing regime.

reasonableness_rules.name: Terrestrial gap plausibility
reasonableness_rules.check: Orbital $/1M tokens >> terrestrial across normal ranges (structural gap). tokcmp stays >1 unless extreme favorable inputs; break-even solver should report 'no solution' for single-parameter util sweep at default.

reasonableness_rules.name: Payload capacity warning
reasonableness_rules.check: When per-launch wet mass exceeds lcap, a 'single launch unit exceeds payload-to-orbit capacity' caution appears in Model cautions.

reasonableness_rules.name: Demisability warning
reasonableness_rules.check: When dry mass > demise threshold and disposal=auto, a controlled re-entry stage is added and a demisability caution appears.

reasonableness_rules.name: Sensitivity tornado ordering
reasonableness_rules.check: Tornado chart is sorted by |effect| descending; top driver = Tokens/s/MW; each bar labels +20%/-20% and sign matches R6-R8.

reasonableness_rules.name: Availability bounds
reasonableness_rules.check: eavail (effective availability) is 0-100% and <= base avail input; replacement-delay and radiation losses reduce it (v3 behavior).

reasonableness_rules.name: Cluster geometry sanity
reasonableness_rules.check: clusterDesign=rect at R_min=500m gives R_max ~1.68km & footprint 40m < 250m shadow limit (OK). Switching to hex/3d changes packing law and may trigger self-shadow flags for an ~80m satellite (documented finding).

reasonableness_rules.name: Timeline plausibility
reasonableness_rules.check: Modeled full deployment months > 0 and scales with sat count / launch cadence (cad). Terrestrial comparator = earthlead. Deployment months increase as cad decreases.

reasonableness_rules.name: Architecture selector is drawing-only
reasonableness_rules.check: Changing mode (individual/module/platform) changes the drawing but leaves capex/tco/tokc unchanged (documented). Verify KPIs identical before/after.

reasonableness_rules.name: Text/label integrity
reasonableness_rules.check: No placeholder/error strings in the UI ('NaN', 'undefined', '[object Object]', 'Infinity', empty derived readouts). All 'computed'/'derived' readouts show a value after recalc.

reasonableness_rules.name: Download round-trip fidelity
reasonableness_rules.check: Downloaded scenario JSON re-imports/reflects the exact current inputs; no field silently dropped.

known_model_cautions_at_baseline: A single launch unit exceeds the configured payload-to-orbit capacity.
At this altitude, active end-of-life disposal should be treated as mandatory.
Auto disposal selected a controlled re-entry stage: dry mass exceeds the 800 kg demisability threshold.
Expected ~2.9 derelict satellites over the analysis horizon from failed disposals.
GB300/HBM is not space-qualified; radiation survival remains a scenario risk.

review_flags: Manual confirmation items — e.g. self-test FAILs, catalog fetch (needs network), any KPI drift from oracle baseline, download side-effects.

permission_and_safety_notes: Download scenario JSON (S8.3), Export modeled fleet (S8.4): these trigger file downloads — a side-effecting action. An autonomous agent should treat downloads as permitted only for this local artifact and verify content in-memory (Blob) where possible.
Load live catalog (S10.1): external network request to CelesTrak. If the runner forbids external fetches, mark S10.1 as BLOCKED (needs network) rather than FAIL.
Pop-out windows (S6.3): open child browser windows; ensure popup blocking is disabled for the test origin.
No credentials, payments, or account actions exist in this app — no prohibited actions are involved.

tag_contract.purpose: Every interactive element and every readout in the app carries an in-element identifier + light metadata as data-test-* attributes, so the UI is self-describing and discoverable without any documentation. Rich detail that will not fit in attributes lives here in the manifest, keyed by the same id. The reconciliation script proves the two agree.
tag_contract.id_rule: data-test-id (controls) / data-test-out (readouts) MUST equal the element's existing DOM id. This keeps the manifest, the flat indexes, and the tags on one key.
required_on_every_interactive_element: data-test-label(short human name; matches the visible label)
optional: data-test-role    (kpi | derived | badge | note | table | warning)
data-test-gated-by(id of the select that unlocks/locks this input, e.g. 'illumMode')
rich_metadata_manifest_only: numeric default / min / max / step beyond native attributes
validity check + expected direction + formula (display_registry.check, reasonableness_rules)
which test suite(s) cover the element

reconciliation.passes_when: dom_only, manifest_only, untagged, attr_mismatch, missing_required_tags are ALL empty

meaning.untagged: element that should carry data-test-* but does not — a new/renamed control added without tagging (primary drift signal)
meaning.dom_only: tagged in the DOM but absent from this manifest — add a manifest entry
meaning.manifest_only: in the manifest but no matching element found — element removed/renamed; update manifest or restore tag
meaning.attr_mismatch: tag 'kind' disagrees with the manifest (hard fail); tab/label differences are reported as soft warnings
meaning.missing_required_tags: tagged element missing one of the required data-test-* attributes

reconciliation.recommended_wiring: Call reconcile() from the app's in-file self-tests (Run self-tests button) and assert report.pass === true, so drift fails the self-test suite.
